title: Can you solve the bridge riddle? - Alex Gendler
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開這座橋的謎語嗎？ - 亞歷克斯詹德勒（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Taking that internship in a remote mountain lab might not have been the best idea.
cues.en: Taking that internship in a remote mountain lab might not have been the best idea.
cues.zh: 在深山裡的實驗室中實習， 可能不是一個好主意。

cues.text: Pulling that lever with the skull symbol just to see what it did
cues.en: Pulling that lever with the skull symbol just to see what it did
cues.zh: 拉下畫有骷髏符號的控制桿， 看看會發生什麼事，

cues.text: probably wasn't so smart, either, but now is not the time for regrets
cues.en: probably wasn't so smart, either, but now is not the time for regrets
cues.zh: 拉下畫有骷髏符號的控制桿， 看看會發生什麼事， 或許也不是個聰明的想法。 但現在，已經沒時間後悔了， 因為你得趕緊逃離 這些突變的殭屍。

cues.text: because you need to get away from these mutant zombies fast.
cues.en: because you need to get away from these mutant zombies fast.
cues.zh: 因為你得趕緊逃離 這些突變的殭屍。 與你同行的，有管理員、 實驗室助理和一位老教授，

cues.text: With you are the janitor, the lab assistant, and the old professor.
cues.en: With you are the janitor, the lab assistant, and the old professor.
cues.zh: 與你同行的，有管理員、 實驗室助理和一位老教授， 雖然你們已經領先一步， 但要安全逃離，還需要：

cues.text: You've gotten a headstart, but there's only one way to safety:
cues.en: You've gotten a headstart, but there's only one way to safety:
cues.zh: 雖然你們已經領先一步， 但要安全逃離，還需要： 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。

cues.text: across an old rope bridge spanning a massive gorge.
cues.en: across an old rope bridge spanning a massive gorge.
cues.zh: 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。 你衝過吊橋只需要 1 分鐘，

cues.text: You can dash across in a minute, while the lab assistant takes two minutes.
cues.en: You can dash across in a minute, while the lab assistant takes two minutes.
cues.zh: 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。 你衝過吊橋只需要 1 分鐘， 然而實驗室助理需要 2 分鐘。 管理員稍慢一些，需要 5 分鐘，

cues.text: The janitor is a bit slower and needs five minutes, and the professor takes a whole ten minutes,
cues.en: The janitor is a bit slower and needs five minutes, and the professor takes a whole ten minutes,
cues.zh: 管理員稍慢一些，需要 5 分鐘， 而教授需要整整 10 分鐘， 因為他走每一步 都要緊握著繩索來前進。

cues.text: holding onto the ropes every step of the way.
cues.en: holding onto the ropes every step of the way.
cues.zh: 因為他走每一步 都要緊握著繩索來前進。

cues.text: By the professor's calculations, the zombies will catch up to you in just over 17 minutes,
cues.en: By the professor's calculations, the zombies will catch up to you in just over 17 minutes,
cues.zh: 根據教授的計算， 在 17 分鐘後， 殭屍就會追上你們，

cues.text: so you only have that much time to get everyone across and cut the ropes.
cues.en: so you only have that much time to get everyone across and cut the ropes.
cues.zh: 在 17 分鐘後， 殭屍就會追上你們， 你只有這麼多的時間， 讓所有人透過吊橋並剪掉繩索。 不幸的是，吊橋同一時間 只能承載兩個人。

cues.text: Unfortunately, the bridge can only hold two people at a time.
cues.en: Unfortunately, the bridge can only hold two people at a time.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，吊橋同一時間 只能承載兩個人。 更糟糕的是，

cues.text: To make matters worse, it's so dark out that you can barely see,
cues.en: To make matters worse, it's so dark out that you can barely see,
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是， 天色太暗， 讓你伸手不見五指， 而你手中的老舊油燈， 只能照亮一個小範圍。

cues.text: and the old lantern you grabbed on your way only illuminates a tiny area.
cues.en: and the old lantern you grabbed on your way only illuminates a tiny area.
cues.zh: 天色太暗， 讓你伸手不見五指， 而你手中的老舊油燈， 只能照亮一個小範圍。 你能想出讓每個人 及時逃脫的方法嗎？

cues.text: Can you figure out a way to have everyone escape in time?
cues.en: Can you figure out a way to have everyone escape in time?
cues.zh: 你能想出讓每個人 及時逃脫的方法嗎？ 記住：不能超過兩人 同時走在吊橋上；

cues.text: Remember: no more than two people can cross the bridge together,
cues.en: Remember: no more than two people can cross the bridge together,
cues.zh: 記住：不能超過兩人 同時走在吊橋上； 跨越吊橋時，若不帶著油燈， 就得走在提燈者旁。

cues.text: anyone crossing must either hold the lantern or stay right next to it,
cues.en: anyone crossing must either hold the lantern or stay right next to it,
cues.zh: 跨越吊橋時，若不帶著油燈， 就得走在提燈者旁。

cues.text: and any of you can safely wait in the dark on either side of the gorge.
cues.en: and any of you can safely wait in the dark on either side of the gorge.
cues.zh: 而所有人都可以安全地待在 漆黑的峽谷兩端。 最重要的是，所有人必須在 殭屍抵達前安全地透過吊橋。

cues.text: Most importantly, everyone must be safely across before the zombies arrive.
cues.en: Most importantly, everyone must be safely across before the zombies arrive.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，所有人必須在 殭屍抵達前安全地透過吊橋。 否則，當殭屍一踏上橋時， 橋上的人會使吊橋負荷過重而斷裂。

cues.text: Otherwise, the first zombie could step on the bridge while people are still on it.
cues.en: Otherwise, the first zombie could step on the bridge while people are still on it.
cues.zh: 否則，當殭屍一踏上橋時， 橋上的人會使吊橋負荷過重而斷裂。 最後，不能用任何花招。

cues.text: Finally, there are no tricks to use here.
cues.en: Finally, there are no tricks to use here.
cues.zh: 最後，不能用任何花招。

cues.text: You can't swing across, use the bridge as a raft, or befriend the zombies.
cues.en: You can't swing across, use the bridge as a raft, or befriend the zombies.
cues.zh: 你不能用繩索擺盪過去， 也不能把橋做成木筏， 或者和殭屍當朋友。

cues.text: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.en: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.zh: 如果你想要自己找出答案， 請按下暫停鈕。

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 如果你想要自己找出答案， 請按下暫停鈕。 還有 3 秒、 2 秒、 1 秒、 一開始，你可能會認為 無論怎麼試，

cues.text: At first it might seem like no matter what you do, you're just a minute or two short of time, but there is a way.
cues.en: At first it might seem like no matter what you do, you're just a minute or two short of time, but there is a way.
cues.zh: 一開始，你可能會認為 無論怎麼試， 始終會差個一、兩分鐘， 但確實是有辦法的。 關鍵就在於： 讓最慢的兩人走在一起，

cues.text: The key is to minimize the time wasted by the two slowest people
cues.en: The key is to minimize the time wasted by the two slowest people
cues.zh: 關鍵就在於： 讓最慢的兩人走在一起， 來減少他們所需要花的時間。

cues.text: by having them cross together.
cues.en: by having them cross together.
cues.zh: 來減少他們所需要花的時間。 而且，要有人提著油燈走回來 這總共需要兩趟，

cues.text: And because you'll need to make a couple of return trips with the lantern,
cues.en: And because you'll need to make a couple of return trips with the lantern,
cues.zh: 而且，要有人提著油燈走回來 這總共需要兩趟，

cues.text: you'll want to have the fastest people available to do so.
cues.en: you'll want to have the fastest people available to do so.
cues.zh: 而且，要有人提著油燈走回來 這總共需要兩趟， 你需要讓跑得最快的人 來做這件事， 所以，你先和實驗室助理 提著油燈快速透過，

cues.text: So, you and the lab assistant quickly run across with the lantern,
cues.en: So, you and the lab assistant quickly run across with the lantern,
cues.zh: 所以，你先和實驗室助理 提著油燈快速透過， 然而你必須放慢一些 來配合他的速度。

cues.text: though you have to slow down a bit to match her pace.
cues.en: though you have to slow down a bit to match her pace.
cues.zh: 然而你必須放慢一些 來配合他的速度。

cues.text: After two minutes, both of you are across, and you, as the quickest, run back with the lantern.
cues.en: After two minutes, both of you are across, and you, as the quickest, run back with the lantern.
cues.zh: 兩分鐘後， 你們兩人都透過吊橋， 然後跑得最快的你， 再迅速提著油燈返回， 這樣只花了三分鐘。

cues.text: Only three minutes have passed.
cues.en: Only three minutes have passed.
cues.zh: 這樣只花了三分鐘。 到目前為止都相當順利。

cues.text: So far, so good.
cues.en: So far, so good.
cues.zh: 到目前為止都相當順利。 最難的部分來了。

cues.text: Now comes the hard part.
cues.en: Now comes the hard part.
cues.zh: 最難的部分來了。 教授和管理員 提著油燈一起過橋，

cues.text: The professor and the janitor take the lantern and cross together.
cues.en: The professor and the janitor take the lantern and cross together.
cues.zh: 最難的部分來了。 教授和管理員 提著油燈一起過橋， 這花了他們 10 分鐘，

cues.text: This takes them ten minutes since the janitor has to slow down for the old professor
cues.en: This takes them ten minutes since the janitor has to slow down for the old professor
cues.zh: 這花了他們 10 分鐘， 因為管理員必須 為了老教授放慢腳步， 教授喃喃自語抱怨著： 他當初不該讓殭屍擁有夜視能力。

cues.text: who keeps muttering that he probably shouldn't have given the zombies night vision.
cues.en: who keeps muttering that he probably shouldn't have given the zombies night vision.
cues.zh: 教授喃喃自語抱怨著： 他當初不該讓殭屍擁有夜視能力。 當他們跨越吊橋時，

cues.text: By the time they're across, there are only four minutes left,
cues.en: By the time they're across, there are only four minutes left,
cues.zh: 當他們跨越吊橋時， 只剩下 4 分鐘， 而你仍困在對岸。

cues.text: and you're still stuck on the wrong side of the bridge.
cues.en: and you're still stuck on the wrong side of the bridge.
cues.zh: 而你仍困在對岸。

cues.text: But remember, the lab assistant has been waiting on the other side,
cues.en: But remember, the lab assistant has been waiting on the other side,
cues.zh: 而你仍困在對岸。 但是記住，實驗室助理 已經在另一邊待命， 而她是隊伍中跑第二快的人。

cues.text: and she's the second fastest of the group.
cues.en: and she's the second fastest of the group.
cues.zh: 而她是隊伍中跑第二快的人。 所以她從教授手中拿起油燈，

cues.text: So she grabs the lantern from the professor and runs back across to you.
cues.en: So she grabs the lantern from the professor and runs back across to you.
cues.zh: 所以她從教授手中拿起油燈， 快速跑回去你那邊。 現在只剩下 2 分鐘， 你們兩位最後一次過橋，

cues.text: Now with only two minutes left, the two of you make the final crossing.
cues.en: Now with only two minutes left, the two of you make the final crossing.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下 2 分鐘， 你們兩位最後一次過橋， 當你踏上峽谷的另一側，

cues.text: As you step on the far side of the gorge, you cut the ropes and collapse the bridge behind you,
cues.en: As you step on the far side of the gorge, you cut the ropes and collapse the bridge behind you,
cues.zh: 當你踏上峽谷的另一側， 你剪斷繩索， 摧毀身後的吊橋， 時間剛好趕上。

cues.text: just in the nick of time.
cues.en: just in the nick of time.
cues.zh: 時間剛好趕上。

cues.text: Maybe next summer, you'll just stick to the library.
cues.en: Maybe next summer, you'll just stick to the library.
cues.zh: 時間剛好趕上。 或許，明年夏天 你只會想泡在圖書館內。
